# PR 001 — Test held-out glasses in an image toy world

> Reconstructed on 2026-10-11. Historical evidence window: 2026-10-04 18:31–18:36 UTC.

**Branch:** `research/exp-01-overly-easy-image-world`  
**Base:** `main`  
**Tag:** `v0.1.0`

## Hypothesis

A router trained on non-glasses perturbations will reweight RGB, edge, high-pass, and chromatic experts under held-out glasses.

## Result

Every fusion strategy reached 1.000 accuracy on clean and glasses inputs. The perturbation did not invalidate enough evidence.

## Review decision

Merge the negative design result because it explains the next construction. Replace the world with a dominant fragile cue and weaker stable backups.
